description: Cast an hour-based Qi Men Dun Jia (奇门遁甲) chart for a moment and place: four pillars, ju, Chief Star and Door, and for each of the nine palaces the deity, star, door, heaven/earth/hidden stems, void, horse star, punishment and door pressure, plus detected patterns, palace scores for the chosen focus and the lucky directions.

datetime.description: Local wall-clock time "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" in `timezone`. Omit for now.

focus.description: What the question is about; changes palace scores and lucky directions. Default general.

longitude.description: Longitude of the place in degrees, east positive, west negative. Default: the standard meridian of the time zone.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. "Asia/Shanghai", "America/New_York". Default Asia/Shanghai.

name: qimen_chart
title: Qi Men Dun Jia chart
